description:
PC control software for Thorlabs EXULUS spatial light modulators.

The Thorlabs EXULUS software package provides PC control of the Thorlabs EXULUS-SE1, EXULUS-HD2, EXULUS-HD3, EXULUS-HD4, EXULUS-HD2HP, and EXULUS-HD3HP spatial light modulators (SLMs). It includes a graphical user interface for operating the SLMs and ships LabVIEW, C++, and Python SDKs for third-party development support.
